title: 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS 454 LS6 · M22 Sport Coupe
variant: SS 454 LS6, heavy-duty close-ratio manual, standard axle · 2-door Sport Coupe (13637) · 4-speed manual · US

facts.label: Curb weight
facts.note: PDF p.153, AMA Weights; 2,091 front + 1,615 rear. GM AMA LS6 13637 baseline curb, mandatory power discs/suspension/four-speed/tires included; option increments listed separately. No driver specified.

facts.label: Curb weight · alternate source
facts.note: Museum lists curb for its LS6 M22 exhibit. Options and protocol insufficient to reconcile; do not use as baseline.

facts.label: Static weight on front axle
facts.note: GM AMA PDF p.153: 2091 lb front ÷ 3706 lb curb = 0.564220…, rounded to 4 decimals; ignore passenger loading incremental percentages. Same listed curb state as curb_weight; no driver reported.

facts.label: Wheelbase
facts.note: GM kit PDF p.77: Malibu Sport Coupe body; 13637. No LS6-specific tread used.

facts.label: Rated power (gross)
facts.note: GM AMA p.131, period published brake horsepower; gross-era rating, not directly comparable to modern SAE net.

facts.label: Rated torque (gross)
facts.note: GM AMA p.131, published peak torque in corresponding gross-era convention.

facts.label: Displacement
facts.note: GM AMA PDF p.131; 454 in³ × 0.016387064 L/in³, rounded to 2 decimals.

facts.label: Final drive ratio
facts.note: GM AMA power team p.130 standard axle; separate 4.10 special axle.
